crossRefs.note: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the…
Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will…
In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice…
I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and…
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures…

translations.web: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
translations.bsb: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
translations.kjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
